topic: Weekly bar nights with tabs and rides vs hosting friends at home with a rotation (Judd vs Harmony)

scenes.narration: One weekly bar night costs more than a car payment. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a bar tab receipt as long as a jump rope, comic burst banner reads CAR PAYMENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Judd and Harmony both love a Friday night with friends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man judd and woman harmony each with a group of friends on a Friday, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Judd hits the bar every Friday. Drinks, appetizers, and a rideshare home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man judd at a crowded bar with cocktails, wings, and a phone showing a rideshare, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His average night runs seventy five dollars with tip.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a bar receipt reading SEVENTY FIVE WITH TIP, man judd signing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fifty two Fridays later, that is thirty nine hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading THIRTY NINE HUNDRED, man judd sweating, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He cannot remember half those nights, but the card statement can.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man judd squinting at a statement full of bar names, a blurry thought bubble, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harmony starts a hosting rotation. Each friend hosts once a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman harmony with a calendar showing four friends names on four Fridays, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Host night costs her forty dollars for snacks and drinks for everyone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman harmony at a grocery checkout with snacks and a bottle, a receipt reads FORTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The other three Fridays cost her nothing but a ride to a friend.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman harmony walking to a friend house carrying a board game, a tag reads FREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her year total, four hundred eighty dollars, and better conversations.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a scoreboard reading FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY, friends laughing around a living room table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Judd spent thirty four hundred more for louder music.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man judd shouting over bar noise, woman harmony laughing at a game night, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Host once, visit three times, keep the difference. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading HOST DO NOT TAB, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
